project.purpose: R2.1 responsibility decomposition of existing non-authoritative task-local Composition APIs. Source- and consumer-scoped architecture, not proof of installed/domain behavior and not another composition engine.

nodes.label: TaskLocalCircuitContract
nodes.responsibility: Validate an already authored task-local Cognitive Circuit and deterministically compile declared stages, typed port references, declared prerequisite ordering and cross-owner Gate requirements; do not select strategies or execute stages.
nodes.authority: Composition API; caller/domain owns objective and selected capabilities
outputs: canonical deterministic circuit projection and non-authoritative validation result
nodes.behavioralContract: Unknown stages/ports, dependency cycles, missing required Gate bindings and malformed identity reject; output ordering is deterministic. Gate closure is not semantic or domain acceptance.
acceptance: validate_manifest and compile_manifest current source/test contracts remain intact; negative malformed and cycle fixtures reject
Consumer-native CLI/API contract, not a new canonical module ontology
formalObligations: Native schema/DAG and Gate non-vacuity established only at bounded source; no abstract model to installed circuit claim
nodes.replacement: Replace only under observed caller-facing manifest acceptance, deterministic projection, Gate and error contract compatibility
nodes.nextAction: Trace bounded Next and package CLI consumers before any replacement.

nodes.label: InterfaceContractDecision
nodes.responsibility: Evaluate a supplied interface expectation and observation for shape compatibility, currentness and evidence admissibility without equating any of these judgments with behavioral refinement.
nodes.authority: Composition interface evaluation API; domain/effect owner retains behavior truth
nodes.behavioralContract: Separates interface compatibility from live behavior and source-current evidence; match by declaration must never imply substitutability.
nodes.consumerQualification: PACKAGE_EXPORT_AND_CLI_SOURCE_ONLY; no source proof external web-security file consumes evaluate_interface; installed consumer UNKNOWN
acceptance: Native interface contract tests check mismatched expectations and evidence standing
No promotion from interface compatibility to real behavioral equivalence
nodes.replacement: Check same decision distinction, negative fixtures and exact evidence scope
nodes.nextAction: Investigate exact consumers for compatibility decisions.

nodes.label: ScopedVerifierObligationBinding
nodes.responsibility: Project existing Gate contracts into immutable task-local verification obligations and validate caller-selected exact verifier binding identities and support scope.
nodes.authority: Composition source interface; verifier owner decides proof
inputs: validated Cognitive Circuit and caller-provided verifier bindings
outputs: digest-bound scoped obligation set and binding standing
nodes.behavioralContract: Stale obligation digest, foreign Gate, widened support or mismatched owner rejects; a resolved binding never implies verifier execution or success.
acceptance: Source Gate and obligation digests bound; negative foreign and stale bindings rejected
No empty-bound-set vacuous accepted domain claim
formalObligations: Verifier encoded property psi to required goal phi bridge remains externally owned
nodes.replacement: Preserve exact Gate/binding provenance, support scope and fail-closed negative controls
nodes.nextAction: Bind selected verifier obligation to real consumer-native proof and implementation context.

nodes.label: SuccessorCandidateComparisonContract
nodes.responsibility: Validate a caller-authored predecessor/candidate replacement comparison and its explicit verifier-owned succession gate receipts, without generating candidates or promoting replacements.
nodes.authority: Composition successor contract; natural consumer owns replacement decision
inputs: predecessor and candidate identities; scoped successor gates and results
outputs: successor contract projection and mechanical gate evaluation
nodes.behavioralContract: Insufficient or mismatched Gate evidence cannot grant semantic replacement; no model result implies configured/deployed substitution.
acceptance: Native successor tests prove only mechanical identity/binding invariants
Real implementation and configured-owner acceptance remain UNKNOWN
formalObligations: Contextual refinement, authority and actual source-to-deployment binding required before safe substitution
nodes.replacement: Preserve honest separation of successor Gate evaluation and domain-authorized rollout
nodes.nextAction: Trace current admitted successor use versus historical demonstration.

nodes.label: ProofImpactQualification
nodes.responsibility: Select which existing scoped obligations require recheck, could retain evidence, or must remain UNKNOWN when source/contract/verifier-binding inputs change; never declare unproved proof reuse.
nodes.authority: Composition task-local impact API; Git/owner verifier retain source and proof authority
inputs: previous and current source-qualified obligations, verifier bindings and observed impact manifests
outputs: scoped requalification and conservative reuse candidates
nodes.behavioralContract: Unknown/missing dynamic readsets and unqualified verifier changes cannot be silently treated as unchanged; REUSE_CANDIDATE is not formal PASS.
acceptance: Negative impact deltas do not promote UNKNOWN to PASS
Same SourceCut and adequate verifier bridge required for reusable proof claim
formalObligations: Real dependency readset totality/negative dynamic consumer closure UNKNOWN
nodes.replacement: Preserve three-valued impact semantics with comparable independent negative examples
nodes.nextAction: Trace actual callers of impact selection across Owners.

slices.label: QualifiedCompositionSourceResponsibilities
acceptance: All declared source implementations and bounded package API/CLI consumers qualified; external installed callers and formal realization remain separate
slices.nextAction: Trace actual runtime/domain consumers for replacement and proof scope.
